title_lines: 八年开发 定价80美元

subtitles.en: Today, Tate's who shares are absolutely soaring, up more than 7%, as the company prepares to release the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6.
subtitles.zh: 今天，Tate's的股价大幅上涨，涨幅超过7%，因为公司准备发布备受期待的《侠盗猎车手6》。

subtitles.en: Tomorrow, the early reviews are overwhelmingly positive.
subtitles.zh: 明天，早期评测结果 overwhelmingly 积极。

subtitles.en: Our own Jason Shryer, calling it, quote, a masterpiece joining us now, Bloomberg Cecilia de Anastasio, covering all things video games, and like,
subtitles.zh: 我们自己的Jason Shryer称其为“杰作”，现在加入我们的是彭博社的Cecilia de Anastasio，她报道所有游戏相关的内容，而且，

subtitles.en: it seems real. The game, and you and I have not yet had a chance to play, but it's that good.
subtitles.zh: 看起来是真的。这款游戏，你和我还没有机会玩，但它就是那么好。

subtitles.en: Everyone's calling it a masterpiece. It has a 98 out of 100 score on Metacritic.
subtitles.zh: 大家都称它为杰作。它在Metacritic上的评分是98分（满分100）。

subtitles.en: It's one of the highest-reviewed games of all time. You know this industry, right?
subtitles.zh: 这是有史以来评价最高的游戏之一。你了解这个行业，对吧？

subtitles.en: Like, how normal is that? You know, and how it works. People get that early access.
subtitles.zh: 这有多正常？你知道它是怎么运作的。人们会获得早期访问权限。

subtitles.en: They play... Jason played for like 45 hours.
subtitles.zh: 他们玩……Jason玩了大约45个小时。

subtitles.en: Some reviewers played for more than 100. Okay, so these are real reviews with real enthusiasm based on real gameplay.
subtitles.zh: 一些评测者玩了超过100小时。所以这些是真实的评测，基于真实游戏体验的真实热情。

subtitles.en: 100%. And the thing about Grand Theft Auto 6, it took eight years, 4,700 people to develop.
subtitles.zh: 100%。关于《侠盗猎车手6》，它花了八年时间，4700人参与开发。

subtitles.en: Some people estimate it cost more than a billion dollars to make.
subtitles.zh: 有人估计制作成本超过十亿美元。

subtitles.en: And it had two delays. And so the anticipation's been building, and it seems like the game really, really delivers as well.
subtitles.zh: 它经历了两次延期。所以期待值一直在累积，而游戏似乎也确实不负众望。

subtitles.en: It's going to be available on PlayStation, on Xbox platforms.
It's going to be $80. $80. I mean, how do people feel about that going into it?
subtitles.zh: 售价将是80美元。80美元。大家对此怎么看？

subtitles.en: Video games cost $60 since I was a kid.
subtitles.zh: 从我小时候起，电子游戏就一直卖60美元。

results.title: GTA 6 Took 8 Years and 4,711 Staff, Bloomberg Says - Pixel Herald
results.snippet: The short version GTA 6 co-heads Phil Hooker and Aaron Garbut told Bloomberg the studio's next game won't take 8 years . Rockstar grew from 2,441 staff in 2018 to 4,711 across 12 offices by 2026, with 4,020 in development and QA. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with PC reportedly planned for early 2027.

results.title: GTA 6 Took Eight Years, Three Bosses, Two Delays and a ... - GTA BOOM
results.snippet: For years Rockstar juggled several games at once across its offices. For GTA 6 , it pointed the bulk of the company at a single project, a focus that explains why one game could swallow eight years and, by Bloomberg's account, almost certainly the biggest budget in gaming. The people in charge changed too.

results.title: GTA 6 Bloomberg Report Explains Why It Took 8 Years
results.snippet: What did Bloomberg reveal about GTA 6's development ? GTA 6 took more than eight years and two delays, and the studio nearly doubled in size to get it done. Bloomberg counts 4,711 staff across 12 offices, and Polygon reports 4,020 of them work in development and QA (quality assurance, the testers).

results.title: Inside GTA 6: what Rockstar told Bloomberg's Jason Schreier about eight ...

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
